verdict.rationale: Inside the product, Honeybadger offers a "Describe your search" panel that turns a plain-language description into an error search query. Anomaly detection also flags statistically unusual error rates against a learned baseline. Deeper pattern analysis and investigation help are delivered through external AI assistants connected via the MCP server, not as in-product AI insights. Missing for 10: in-product AI-generated insights or summaries of errors, AI fix or root-cause suggestions, explicit confirmation that the search panel is AI-driven, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
